notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/labs/imswitch__imswitch --backend fake (exit 0; evidence contract_checked, not an MHS-Device level; check-report.json has no findings and is regenerated by every gate run). The card lists several entry symbols for the ImSwitch application; this package implements the first confirmed device class, imswitch.imcontrol.model.interfaces.standamotor:StandaMotor (the Standa 8SMC5 motor controller for a motorized rotation mount). ViewSetupInfo is the setup/configuration dataclass, HyphaController is the application controller, IC_Camera is one camera interface and SmarACTPositionerManager is another positioner; they are named in facts.md and are not part of this package. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the package is a direct Driver with a native.py factory instead of the PythonObjectDriver helper, because the upstream constructor needs the libximc directory, the controller index and the two step counts, and the stop is a native controller command. NOT COVERED: the upstream continuous rotation (start_cont_rot), relative move (moverel), speed write (set_rot_speed, mrpm), sync-in/out settings, device information (test_info) and software zero (set_zero_pos) are not exposed; only the position read, the absolute move, the stop and the e-stop are. The travel range is not stated anywhere in the clone, so joint_positions is Limit.operator_required and every move is refused MHS.SAFETY.LIMITS_UNSET until the operator supplies an envelope; site-limits.example.json is an example, not a statement about a unit. The fake is a package fake because the upstream MockStandaMotor is incomplete (no wait_for_stop or stop_cont_rot) and lives in the native module; it does not model motion over time, speed, continuous rotation or controller errors. The hardware backend (native.py) and the upstream package were never executed and no hardware run is claimed. The package is R1 and model-authored with reviewed_by null, so the loader does not refuse its hardware backend on review grounds; the backend remains an operator decision.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-10-30; reviewed_by stays null): accepted; the reviewer changed no file of the package. After the registry rebuild refreshed task.json, the reviewer re-ran the gate and wrote its digest above.
